style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet soft childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cherry-pink #F5AEBE, clean white #FFFFFF, mist-blue #DCE9F2 and charcoal text #3A3A3C; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line garment icon style; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set, garment always fully steamed and wrinkle-free
